cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a cosmetics counter — a glass shelf of lipsticks, a lit mirror, a stool and pastel displays
cuts.scene: she is a trainee standing at the counter, carefully inspecting a lip brush held in one hand while the other hand rests naturally at her side
cuts.outfit: a makeup artist look fitted to her body — a fitted short-sleeved beauty smock tied at the waist and a short skirt, bare legs, a plain pink brush belt
